Can I use Rub It In with other active ingredients like Retinol or AHAs?

Rub It In can be layered with other actives, but apply it first and allow 30–60 seconds before adding anything else. If you use retinol, use Rub It In in the morning and retinol at night to avoid over-stimulation. It pairs well with Vitamin C as Niacinamide and Vitamin E enhance its brightening effect.
